ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: There are five puzzle pieces in the picture. The upper edge and lower edge of each piece are straight horizontal edges, indicating that after being assembled they should form a horizontal rectangle. On the five pieces are written respectively two “2”s, one “0”, one “1”, and one short horizontal-line minus sign. Reasoning: According to the matching of side protrusions and recesses, the “2” piece with a flat left side is placed on the far left, the minus-sign piece is connected to its right, then the “1” piece and the “0” piece are connected in order, and finally the other “2” piece with a flat right side closes the right end. Thus the expression read from left to right is 2 - 102. Calculating gives 2 - 102 = -100.

Reading the symbols left to right gives the calculation 2 - 102. Evaluate it as 2 - 102 = -100.
